criteria.name: Identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: GIS FID 797 is UC / University Church; saved shell bounds compare to transformed polygon with max axis-bound error 0.0000 m.

criteria.name: Position, orientation and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: GIS-derived campus-coordinate shell aligns with source outline bounds; facade orientation is inferred because the floor plan has no north arrow and photograph lacks camera azimuth.

criteria.name: Height, floors and roof form
criteria.evidence: The state record confirms a multi-story building and GIS reports conflicting counts (Level_=4, NUM_LEVELS=1, CountOfFLO=3); all heights and slate gable dimensions are estimates without measured elevation evidence.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The saved reference photo supports red brick, four-column portico, triangular pediment, a square green spired tower, steps, a circular pediment oculus and arched side windows. Model contains the oculus=True and 105 arched window heads; tower is placed beyond the portico along the same wing. Cardinal facade mapping remains inferred.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability and evidence
criteria.evidence: Expected scene and collection are present (826 objects); all five raw source snapshots exist=True; external file textures=0; evidence notes source conflicts and uncertainty.

findings: Roof and floor heights need independent elevation or multi-view photo verification.
Confirm portico/tower facade assignment with a geotagged or cardinally oriented reference; the photo places the tower beyond the portico along the same wing.
